tools.name: check_drug_coverage
tools.title: Check formulary evidence
tools.description: Evaluate up to 100 exact plan/drug pairs, preserving five-state evidence, unresolved tiers and nullable restrictions.

tools.name: check_ichra_affordability
tools.title: Check ICHRA affordability
tools.description: Check whether an individual coverage HRA is affordable for one employee. Returns the lowest cost silver plan on gross and EHB-portion premiums, the required HRA contribution and one verdict per income measure, with cited rules. Not a bindable quote. Employer safe harbors come from a proposed rule and say so.

tools.name: check_provider_network
tools.title: Check network evidence
tools.description: Evaluate up to 100 exact plan/NPI pairs using issuer record scope; addresses never establish participation.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch an evidence record
tools.description: Read a typed ID returned by this server, with bounded detail sections; never accepts a URL or path.

tools.name: get_data_status
tools.title: Inspect loaded data
tools.description: Read the local capability manifest, issuer/year/state gaps, source completeness and personalized access policy.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.title: Read a plan
tools.description: Read an exact HIOS or state plan key and year, with optional CSR variant and paged benefits, documents or provenance.

tools.name: list_carriers_networks
tools.title: List carriers or networks
tools.description: List scoped issuer or network records for an explicit state and optional year. IDs retain publication scope.

tools.name: lookup_geography
tools.title: Resolve ZIP counties
tools.description: Resolve imported ZIP/county evidence, preserving multi-county ambiguity and labelled approximate fallbacks.

tools.name: quote_plans
tools.title: Quote plans by age and ZIP
tools.description: Quote plans by age and ZIP. Public tier: no income, subsidy or names; tobacco is optional. Provider and drug coverage per plan with evidence status. Not a bindable quote.

tools.name: quote_premiums
tools.title: Quote household premiums
tools.description: Household quote with gross, estimated credit/net and full rate evidence. Income and ages are never logged. Not a bindable quote; CSR eligibility is not evaluated.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search public evidence
tools.description: Discover literal plan, provider, drug, geography, carrier, network and dataset matches; scope gaps are explicit.

tools.name: search_drugs
tools.title: Find exact drug concepts
tools.description: Search unique RxCUIs by literal name or published NDC; select an exact concept before checking coverage.

tools.name: search_medicare_plans
tools.title: Search Medicare plans
tools.description: List the Medicare Advantage, Part D and SNP plans CMS lists for one county and contract year, with their filed premiums, MOOP and stars. Provider networks stay unknown because CMS publishes no central file.

tools.name: search_plans
tools.title: Find health plans
tools.description: List plans for an explicit year and ZIP/county. Ambiguous counties need a selection; eligibility is unknown.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.title: Find provider identities
tools.description: Search literal names, exact NPIs, taxonomy or plan records with optional radius filtering before pagination. Identity alone proves no network membership.

tools.name: estimate_medicare_drug_costs
tools.title: Estimate Medicare drug costs
tools.description: Estimate one Medicare Part D plan's covered-drug costs for an ordered fill schedule in the non-LIS scenario, from CMS benefit files and annual rules. Every figure cites its evidence; amounts without prices stay unknown. A bounded figure is a range from minimum_cents to maximum_cents, not one cost. Benefit type and drug classes come from CMS files, never the caller. The server keeps no copy of the schedule. Not a bindable quote, and premiums are not evaluated.

tools.name: get_lowest_premiums
tools.title: Lowest metal premium
tools.description: Find the lowest gross on-exchange silver, bronze, expanded bronze or gold premium for one age, year and location. Tobacco can be selected. Requires complete pricing evidence. Does not evaluate subsidies.

tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.title: Market summary
tools.description: Count base plans and issuers by metal, with optional gross premium ranges.

tools.name: get_benchmark
tools.title: Silver household benchmark
tools.description: Read the existing January 1 non-tobacco household silver benchmark, with EHB and pediatric dental adjustments and full evidence.

tools.name: compare_market_costs
tools.title: Individual offer distribution
tools.description: Gross monthly prices across eligible public base plans for one exact age or an explicitly listed non-tobacco household. Counts gaps; no group quote, subsidy or employer inputs. Evidence pages require the returned generation.

tools.name: get_allowance_range
tools.title: Allowance range
tools.description: Calculate the named four-profile gross premium range and adjusted SLCSP context for one ZIP and year.

tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Service status
tools.description: Returns a compact public status summary: version, database state, coverage counts, source and import age counts, cache state, pass-through budget counts and plugin count. Use section (sources, worker or passthrough), offset and limit (1-100, default 50) for details. Source details include publisher date and its recorded origin. Results stay below 64 KiB; truncated and page.omitted label size omissions. Follow page.next_offset for more. Full public detail remains at /status.json.
